messages:
Maria: Hey team — NebulaPay RFP landed. They require on‑prem/private deployment with customer‑managed HSM (Thales or Azure HSM), VPC peering, and a 3‑week POC. They attached a security questionnaire: https://drive.google.com/nebulapay-sec-q
Devin: I can run the POC. Need test dataset, target qps/latency, and acceptance criteria. Can we offer a 3‑week Dedicated trial or do they insist on Private? @Paul?
Paul: Two paths: 1) Dedicated trial (reserved GPU pool, temporary discounted rate) — estimated cost for 3 weeks: ~$12k (1x A100‑equivalent pool) with 20% trial discount. 2) Private deployment (license + infra) — one‑time platform fee + infra costs; typical PoC starter: $45k setup + monthly infra. For RFP I'll draft line items. Need exact GPU count from Devin.
Ali: SE note — For HSM: Private supports customer‑managed KMS via keywrap/KMIP brokers. Thales generally fine but need to confirm firmware/version. For Dedicated (hosted) we only support customer KMS when network peering/VPN to Private is arranged. I'll enumerate supported KMS integrations in the RFI.
Sarah: I’ll take the security questionnaire. Quick flags: SOC2 + ISO27001: yes. FedRAMP: no. Data residency: enforceable in Private. Audit logs and key rotation: available. I’ll upload a completed spreadsheet by EOD.
Devin: Proposed acceptance criteria: 1) 99th pct latency < 250ms at target load (example: 1k qps aggregate for short prompts), 2) Response consistency check on 500 labeled prompts >= 95% pass, 3) KMS integration validated and key rotate tested. Good?
Maria: NebulaPay expects kickoff in ~2 weeks and RFI back by Friday.
Ali: For POC ops — smoke test curl we run (example):
```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-psi-1","input":"Hello world"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Also will provide KV-cache warmup script and a minimal load script (wrk wrapper) in the RFI attachments.
Paul: I’ll prepare a pricing table with variants: Hosted (usage), Dedicated (monthly commit), Private (license + infra). I’ll include: baseline PO C discount, HSM professional services, and estimated network peering costs.
Maria: Can someone confirm we can sign NebulaPay’s standard DPA with minor edits? @Legal?
Sarah: Legal will need the SLA edits; I’ll loop them in. Note caveat: encryption‑at‑rest with customer keys is straightforward in Private but for Dedicated hosted clusters we require peering and approved network topology. Will call that out.
Devin: Action items: Ali -> verify Thales firmware compatibility + deliver network diagram; Paul -> draft pricing & line items; Sarah -> complete sec questionnaire; Devin -> POC test plan + load script; Maria -> send draft RFI by Thu. I’ll create a shared doc: https://drive.google.com/nebulapay-rfp
Maria: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
[deploy-bot]: New file uploaded: NebulaPay_RFI_Doc_v1.xlsx (drive link above)
